FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: FRENCH
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. How do you say 'This is my mother.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est ma sœur.
   B. C'est ma mère.
   C. Ma mère s'appelle Grace.
   D. C'est le bébé.

2. How do you say 'in' in French? (1 mark)
   A. sous
   B. devant
   C. dans
   D. entre

3. Which little word goes with 'télé' (the TV)? (1 mark)
   A. le
   B. l'
   C. les
   D. la

4. Which is the correct spelling of the French word for 'father'? (1 mark)
   A. pére
   B. pere
   C. pèe
   D. père

5. How do you say 'the child' in French? (1 mark)
   A. l'enfant
   B. la famille
   C. la mère
   D. la sœur

6. Fill in: Tournez ______ . (Turn left.) (1 mark)
   A. à droite
   B. à gauche
   C. devant
   D. tout droit

7. How do you say 'the week' in French? (1 mark)
   A. l'église
   B. la semaine
   C. l'école
   D. le jour

8. Which little word goes with 'bouche' (the mouth)? (1 mark)
   A. la
   B. le
   C. les
   D. l'

9. What number is 'huit' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 18
   C. 10
   D. 8

10. What number is 'six' in French? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 17
   C. 10
   D. 16

11. How do you say 'the banana' in French? (1 mark)
   A. le fromage
   B. le thé
   C. la banane
   D. les légumes

12. How do you say the French letter G? (1 mark)
   A. jay
   B. gay
   C. zhay
   D. gee

13. How do you say 'I like milk.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. C'est une banane.
   B. À midi, je mange du riz et des haricots.
   C. Qu'est-ce que c'est ?
   D. J'aime le lait.

14. How do you say 'I like the mango.' in French? (1 mark)
   A. Je n'aime pas le poisson.
   B. À midi, je mange du riz et des haricots.
   C. J'aime la mangue.
   D. Je bois un jus.

15. Which little word goes with 'nuage' (the cloud)? (1 mark)
   A. les
   B. l'
   C. le
   D. la

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into English: 'C'est ma mère.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

17. Translate into English: 'Enchanté !' (2 marks) (2 marks)

18. Translate into English: 'J'ai dix ans.' (2 marks) (2 marks)

19. Explain why it is important to store things safely at home. Give two examples. (4 marks) (4 marks)

20. Translate into English: 'Ma mère s'appelle Grace.' (3 marks) (3 marks)

21. Translate into English: 'J'aime la mangue.' (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
FRENCH — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — C'est ma mère.
   This is my mother. in French is C'est ma mère.

2. C — dans
   in in French is dans.

3. D — la
   télé is feminine, so we say la télé.

4. D — père
   The correct spelling is père, with its accents.

5. A — l'enfant
   the child in French is l'enfant.

6. B — à gauche
   À gauche means to the left.

7. B — la semaine
   the week in French is la semaine.

8. A — la
   bouche is feminine, so we say la bouche.

9. D — 8
   huit means 8.

10. A — 6
   six means 6.

11. C — la banane
   the banana in French is la banane.

12. C — zhay
   In French, G is named zhay.

13. D — J'aime le lait.
   I like milk. in French is J'aime le lait.

14. C — J'aime la mangue.
   I like the mango. in French is J'aime la mangue.

15. C — le
   nuage is masculine, so we say le nuage.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is my mother.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: Pleased to meet you!
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.

18. (2 marks)
   Answer: I am ten years old.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.

19. (4 marks)
   Answer: It stops accidents and damage. Sharp things should be in a drawer and bags should not block walkways.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the reason and 1 mark for each example.

20. (3 marks)
   Answer: My mother is called Grace.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 3 marks in total.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: I like the mango.
   Working / marking points: Award marks for each correct part of the meaning: 2 marks in total.
